features.name: l2_norm_standardized
features.description: L2 norm of z-score standardized key continuous features (V1, V2, V8, V12, V13, V14, V15, V27, V30, V31, V36, V37, V39) using training-set mean and std. Captures overall molecular descriptor magnitude in normalized space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single scalar summarizing how far a sample lies from the feature-space origin in standardized coordinates, improving KNN neighborhood geometry.

features.name: mahalanobis_approx_diagonal
features.description: Diagonal Mahalanobis-like distance approximation using variance-normalized squared deviations for all continuous features. Approximates true Mahalanobis distance assuming diagonal covariance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Variance-normalized distance metric that accounts for feature scale differences, improving KNN distance calculations in heterogeneous feature spaces.

features.name: dist_to_global_centroid
features.description: Euclidean distance from the sample to the global training centroid in the standardized space of V1, V13, V15, V36, V37, V39 (key continuous molecular descriptors).
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how atypical a sample is relative to the overall dataset center, helping KNN identify outliers and boundary samples.

features.name: count_feature_outlier_flags
features.description: Count of features where the standardized value exceeds 2 standard deviations from the training mean, across V1, V2, V8, V12, V13, V15, V30, V31, V36, V37, V39.
features.expected_model_benefit: Indicates how many features are extreme, helping KNN identify samples that may be in sparse regions of the feature space with fewer reliable neighbors.

features.name: molecular_complexity_score
features.description: Composite molecular complexity score combining count-based features (V3, V5, V7, V9, V10, V11, V16) normalized by their training means. Captures structural richness of the molecule.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes molecular structural complexity in a single normalized score, improving KNN neighborhood coherence for structurally similar molecules.

features.name: ratio_v1_v13
features.description: Ratio of V1 (mean first ionization potential proxy) to V13 (another topological descriptor), normalized by training-set ratio mean. Captures relative molecular electronic structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features capture relative relationships between descriptors that may define molecular similarity clusters better than raw values for KNN.

features.name: topological_distance_index
features.description: Composite topological distance index combining V36, V37, V39 (topological/geometric descriptors) standardized and summed. Represents molecular shape and connectivity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates topological descriptors into a single index that captures molecular shape similarity, improving KNN distance calculations for structurally related compounds.

features.name: electronic_descriptor_composite
features.description: Composite of electronic/physicochemical descriptors V12, V14, V17, V18, V22, V27, V28 standardized and combined. Captures electronic properties of the molecule.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates electronic descriptors into a single feature that captures electronic similarity between molecules, improving KNN neighborhood quality.

features.name: sparse_feature_density
features.description: Proportion of sparse/count features (V4, V6, V19, V20, V21, V24, V25, V26, V29, V32, V40) that are non-zero. Indicates how many rare structural features are present.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the density of rare structural features, helping KNN identify samples in sparse regions where neighborhood distances may be less reliable.

features.name: log_transformed_v30
features.description: Log1p transformation of V30 (highly skewed feature with large range 0-71), standardized by training log-mean. Reduces skewness for better KNN distance calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation of skewed V30 reduces the influence of extreme values on KNN distances, improving neighborhood quality for typical samples.

features.name: molecular_descriptor_coherence
features.description: Semantic assessment of how internally coherent the molecular descriptor profile is, based on whether key descriptor ratios (V1/V2, V13/V15, V36/V39) fall within typical ranges seen in drug-like molecules. Score from 0 (incoherent/atypical) to 1 (highly coherent/typical).
features.expected_model_benefit: Coherent descriptor profiles indicate samples that are more likely to have reliable KNN neighbors, improving distance-based predictions.

features.name: structural_complexity_balance
features.description: Semantic assessment of the balance between molecular size indicators (V7, V9, V10, V16) and connectivity descriptors (V33, V34, V35, V38). Score from 0 (highly imbalanced, unusual structure) to 1 (well-balanced, typical structure). Considers whether atom counts and bond counts are proportionally consistent.
features.expected_model_benefit: Structurally balanced molecules tend to cluster together in descriptor space, helping KNN identify coherent neighborhoods of similar compounds.
